title: MetaMask exits Lido validators as it investigates security incident
summary: MetaMask said it has found no immediate threat to its wallets, while Lido warned the precautionary validator exits could result in lost rewards and downtime penalties.

title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
summary: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.
